content: {"reasoning":"The current CO-29 denial reflects an expired filing window, and prior corrections and an appeal have not resolved the claim; another submission or medical-necessity appeal would not address this denial. Authorization is not required, and neither retroauthorization nor peer-to-peer review is available. The contractual timely-filing denial does not establish patient liability despite the remaining deductible, and there is no secondary payer, so the balance is uncollectible through the available actions.","action":"write_off"}
